title: Valgus Stability

figures.claim: Valgus testing is performed at 20 to 30 degrees of flexion rather than in extension, because extension recruits the other structures and hides the ligament.
Conventional teaching gives the superficial medial collateral ligament roughly 50 to 80 per cent of the valgus restraint at 20 to 30 degrees of flexion, which is where it is the clear primary.
Test in extension as well as at 30 degrees, since extension findings change the plan.
